title: TOSS MVP Prototype
objective: Transfer AI-ready project instructions from iPhone to Mac.
context: Build an iPhone-first app called TOSS. Users can record an idea, have AI make a clean handoff, then swipe it over to their Mac so Antigravity can pick up the project. Keep all old versions and don't lose project history.
requirements: Record or type project instructions on iPhone.
Generate editable Markdown and JSON handoffs conforming to schema 1.0.0.
Pair with Mac receiver and securely transfer on user action.
constraints: Working core transfer is more important than animation polish.
No plain text production API keys in client code.
completed: Project repository initialized with modular multi-agent structure.
Handoff schema v1.0.0 defined and sample documents authored.
nextActions: Build SwiftUI capture and review prototype.
Implement macOS receiver with Bonjour advertisement and encrypted endpoint.
Verify end-to-end send/receive loop with SHA-256 checksum validation.

source.rawInput: I want an iPhone app called TOSS. I can record an idea, have AI make a clean handoff, then swipe it over to my Mac so Antigravity can pick up the project. Keep all the old versions and don't lose the project history.
